verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a bulk-operation capability, such as multi-select edits, batch endpoints, or mass move, complete, or assign actions. Everything Views only aggregate items for viewing. The REST API, CLI and MCP support are developer building blocks a user could script loops with, not a bulk-operations feature in themselves. Templates are an adjacent feature for reusing project structure, not bulk actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
